name: Verify conversation context is maintained across multiple turns
objective: Validate that the assistant maintains conversation context when the user provides information across multiple messages.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page

steps.expectedResult: The assistant acknowledges and asks for clarification

steps.description: Provide follow-up information referencing the original context
steps.expectedResult: The assistant maintains context from the first message

steps.description: Verify the response incorporates both messages
steps.expectedResult: The assistant provides assistance relevant to VPN + update context combined
